title: Practice Script

template.description: Template the Area started from: square, horizontal or vertical rectangle (open grass), half-pitch or full-pitch (drawn with pitch markings, which stretch to the width and length). Leave out for open grass.

width.description: Width in whole metres, drawn left to right (the x axis).

length.description: Length in whole metres, drawn top to bottom (the y axis).

area.description: The space the Practice happens in. The grid has one 1 m cell per square metre.

direction.description: Direction of attack for the whole Practice: up (toward row 0, the top edge, where a pitch template draws its try line), down, left, right, or none. When set, any pass caught more than 0.5 m ahead of where it was thrown in that direction raises a warning. Set it for directional drills; leave out or none for drills with no try line.

id.description: Unique id used by placements and moves, e.g. "a1".

team.description: Side the marker plays for. Defaults to attack for attackers and defence for defenders.

label.description: Short role or number shown on the marker, e.g. "9" or "SH". Never a player name.

colour.description: Colour of a cone only, e.g. red, amber and green to mark zones. Defaults to yellow.

items.description: Something drawn in the Area: a player, the ball or equipment.

markers.description: Every marker used in any Step, declared once. At most 3 balls.

marker.description: Id of the marker being placed.

cell.description: Cell the marker starts on. Required for every marker except the ball.

x.description: Column, counted from 0 at the left edge of the Area.

y.description: Row, counted from 0 at the top edge of the Area.

holder.description: For the ball only, instead of a cell: id of the attacker, defender or coach holding it at the start of the Step. The ball rides with its holder.

lying.description: For a tackle shield only: true lays it flat on the ground for the whole Step, as at a ruck or with a ball under a pad. A ball on the same cell is drawn beneath it, partly showing. Leave out for an upright shield.

items.description: Where a marker starts in the Step: a cell, or for the ball a holder, and whether kit is Lying.

placements.description: Markers on the Area in Step 0, each placed at most once. A marker left out must be added by a Progression.

moves.description: At most one move per marker.

marker.description: Id of the marker that moves.

x.description: Column, counted from 0 at the left edge of the Area.

y.description: Row, counted from 0 at the top edge of the Area.

items.description: A grid cell. Cells are 1 m squares; an Area W m wide and L m long has columns 0..W-1 and rows 0..L-1.

waypoints.description: Cells the marker runs to, in order. The marker passes through them without stopping and rests on the last.

pace.description: How fast the marker runs: walk, jog or sprint. Defaults to jog. All Paces are slower than real time.

after.description: Leave out to start at time zero.

move.description: Start when the move of this marker has finished.

pass.description: Start when the pass with this id has been caught.

items.description: A run by one marker from its starting cell. Duration comes from distance and Pace, never typed. The ball cannot move on its own.

passes.description: Passes in the order they happen.

id.description: Unique id for the pass in its Step, e.g. "p1". Used by after.pass, setPass and removePass.

from.description: Id of the marker passing. Must hold the ball when the pass fires.

ball.description: Id of the ball being passed. Leave out to pass the first ball declared in markers, which is the only ball in most Practices. Each ball has its own chain of passes.

at.description: Catch on the run: index (from 0) of a waypoint in the receiver's move. The pass fires when the receiver reaches that waypoint, and the receiver runs the rest of its move holding the ball. Leave out to fire at the end of the move. Only for a receiver with a move.

after.description: Also wait for the move of this marker to finish before the pass fires (draw and pass). Leave out to wait for nothing extra. The marker needs a move in the Step. Waits may not loop.

move.description: Fire when the move of this marker has finished.

kick.description: true makes this pass a kick: the ball flies through the air, slower than a pass, drawn as a dashed arc. A kick is never a forward pass. Leave out for an ordinary pass.

items.description: A pass of a ball. Passes of one ball fire in list order: each fires once the previous one is caught and the receiver has arrived and any move named in "after" has finished (at waypoint "at" of its move if given, else the end of its move, or straight away if it has no move, or if its move is still waiting on this pass). Balls run at the same time.

points.description: Coaching points shown over the Step as it plays. For a Progression, the first says why the Step is harder.

commentary.description: The words shown over a Step as it plays. The viewer can toggle it.

progressions.description: Progressions in order. Progression i is Step i + 1 and builds on Step i.

lever.description: The STEP lever this Progression pulls: Space, Time, Equipment or People.

points.description: Coaching points shown over the Step as it plays. For a Progression, the first says why the Step is harder.

commentary.description: The words shown over a Step as it plays. The viewer can toggle it.

marker.description: Id of a marker that is not on the Area in the previous Step.

cell.description: Cell the marker starts on. Required for every marker except the ball.

x.description: Column, counted from 0 at the left edge of the Area.

y.description: Row, counted from 0 at the top edge of the Area.

oneOf.description: Put a marker on the Area from this Step onward.

marker.description: Id of a marker on the Area in the previous Step.

oneOf.description: Take a marker, and its move, off the Area from this Step onward.

marker.description: Id of a marker on the Area in the previous Step.

x.description: Column, counted from 0 at the left edge of the Area.

y.description: Row, counted from 0 at the top edge of the Area.

items.description: A grid cell. Cells are 1 m squares; an Area W m wide and L m long has columns 0..W-1 and rows 0..L-1.

waypoints.description: Cells the marker runs to, in order. The marker passes through them without stopping and rests on the last.

pace.description: How fast the marker runs: walk, jog or sprint. Defaults to jog. All Paces are slower than real time.

after.description: Leave out to start at time zero.

move.description: Start when the move of this marker has finished.

pass.description: Start when the pass with this id has been caught.

oneOf.description: Add a move for a marker, or replace the marker's existing move.

marker.description: Id of a marker that has a move in the previous Step.

oneOf.description: Remove a marker's move so it stays on its cell.

id.description: Unique id for the pass in its Step, e.g. "p1". Used by after.pass, setPass and removePass.

from.description: Id of the marker passing. Must hold the ball when the pass fires.

ball.description: Id of the ball being passed. Leave out to pass the first ball declared in markers, which is the only ball in most Practices. Each ball has its own chain of passes.

at.description: Catch on the run: index (from 0) of a waypoint in the receiver's move. The pass fires when the receiver reaches that waypoint, and the receiver runs the rest of its move holding the ball. Leave out to fire at the end of the move. Only for a receiver with a move.

after.description: Also wait for the move of this marker to finish before the pass fires (draw and pass). Leave out to wait for nothing extra. The marker needs a move in the Step. Waits may not loop.

move.description: Fire when the move of this marker has finished.

kick.description: true makes this pass a kick: the ball flies through the air, slower than a pass, drawn as a dashed arc. A kick is never a forward pass. Leave out for an ordinary pass.

oneOf.description: Replace the pass with this id in place, or add it after the existing passes.

id.description: Id of a pass in the previous Step.

template.description: Template the Area started from: square, horizontal or vertical rectangle (open grass), half-pitch or full-pitch (drawn with pitch markings, which stretch to the width and length). Leave out for open grass.

width.description: Width in whole metres, drawn left to right (the x axis).

length.description: Length in whole metres, drawn top to bottom (the y axis).

oneOf.description: Replace the Area (its template, width and length) from this Step onward. Only in a Progression that pulls the Space lever. Every cell used from this Step on must fit the new Area.

items.description: One change over the previous Step. Changes apply in order.

changes.description: What this Step changes over the previous Step, applied in order. Empty while a Progression is being built.

items.description: A Step that develops the previous Step. Stores only its change, so edits to earlier Steps carry forward.

description: A Practice Script: a rugby coaching Practice laid out on a grid of cells and animated by moves and passes.
